require "prism"
require "json"
require "digest"

class Inventory < Prism::Visitor
  attr_reader :calls, :defs
  def initialize
    @calls = Hash.new(0)
    @defs = 0
  end
  def visit_call_node(node)
    @calls[node.name.to_s] += 1
    super
  end
  def visit_def_node(node)
    @defs += 1
    super
  end
end

rows = ARGV.map do |root|
  files = Dir.glob("#{root}/**/*", File::FNM_DOTMATCH).select do |path|
    File.file?(path) && !path.split("/").any? { |p| %w[.git .bundle .claude .github .ruby-lsp .vscode log node_modules tmp .lowrail].include?(p) } && %w[.rb .rake .rbs .ru].include?(File.extname(path))
  end.sort
  visitor = Inventory.new
  errors = []
  manifest = files.map do |path|
    bytes = File.binread(path)
    unless path.end_with?(".rbs")
      result = Prism.parse(bytes)
      errors.concat(result.errors.map { |e| {file: path.delete_prefix(root + "/"), line: e.location.start_line, message: e.message} })
      visitor.visit(result.value)
    end
    [path.delete_prefix(root + "/"), Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(bytes), bytes.bytesize]
  end
  {app: File.basename(root) == "rails" ? "wikino" : File.basename(root), file_count: files.size,
   bytes: manifest.sum { |x| x[2] }, manifest_sha256: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(JSON.generate(manifest)),
   defs: visitor.defs, calls: visitor.calls.sort.to_h, parse_errors: errors,
   source_pin: File.read(File.join(File.basename(root) == "rails" ? File.dirname(root) : root, ".lowrail-corpus-source")).strip}
end
puts JSON.pretty_generate({ruby: RUBY_DESCRIPTION, prism: Prism::VERSION, apps: rows})

import json
import pathlib
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import time

root = pathlib.Path('/home/user/workspace/repo')
out = pathlib.Path('/tmp/lowrail-rubydex-research')
apps = ['rubydex-blog', 'fizzy', 'casa', 'writebook', 'wikino', 'codetriage', 'pingcrm', 'redprints-cfp', 'react-starter-kit']
binaries = {
    'pinned': out / 'pinned/rust/target/release/rubydex_cli',
    'pr1078': out / 'target-main/release/rubydex_cli',
}
results = []
for round_ in range(3):
    for app in apps:
        path = root / '.corpus' / app
        if app == 'wikino':
            path = path / 'rails'
        order = list(binaries) if round_ % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(binaries))
        for arm in order:
            started = time.perf_counter()
            rss_path = out / 'rss.txt'
            result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/time', '-f', '%M', '-o', str(rss_path), str(binaries[arm]), str(path), '--stats'], capture_output=True, text=True)
            wall = time.perf_counter() - started
            text = result.stdout
            metric = lambda regex: re.search(regex, text).group(1)
            stages = {stage.lower(): float(metric(r'  ' + stage + r'\s+([0-9.]+)s')) for stage in ['Listing', 'Indexing', 'Resolution', 'Querying', 'Total:']}
            row = dict(app=app, arm=arm, round=round_, wall_seconds=wall,
                       max_rss_bytes=int(metric(r'Maximum RSS: ([0-9]+) bytes')),
                       external_max_rss_bytes=int(rss_path.read_text().strip())*1024,
                       stages_seconds=stages, files_reported=int(metric(r'Indexed (\d+) files')),
                       declarations=int(metric(r'Found (\d+) names')),
                       definitions=int(metric(r'Found (\d+) definitions')),
                       exit_code=result.returncode, stderr=result.stderr)
            results.append(row)
            (out / 'measurements-raw.json').write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + '\n')
            print(app, arm, round_, f'{wall:.4f}s', f'{row["max_rss_bytes"]/1048576:.2f}MiB', row['exit_code'], flush=True)
for app in apps:
    for arm in binaries:
        runs = [x for x in results if x['app'] == app and x['arm'] == arm]
        print('SUMMARY', app, arm,
              'wall', round(statistics.median(x['wall_seconds'] for x in runs), 4),
              'rss', round(statistics.median(x['max_rss_bytes'] for x in runs)/1048576, 2),
              'files', [x['files_reported'] for x in runs],
              'defs', [x['definitions'] for x in runs], flush=True)
